description:
Why does everything cost so much? Every week we take one bill from American life (gas, rent, car insurance, groceries, healthcare) and itemize it line by line with the government's own data, so you can see exactly who gets your money.

No hype, no stock tips: just the receipt. Every number on screen comes with its source.

Every bill has a receipt. We itemize them.

videos.title: Why Your Electric Bill Is So High (It's Not the Power)
Coffee Hit $9.30 a Pound. The Farmer Gets 3 to 6 Cents
America Ran Out of Cows. Here's What It Costs You
Gas Hit $4.50. Who is legally robbing you?
